FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 380
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/16/2026
House Bill 380 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment which, if ratified, would
allow two or more contiguous county boards of education to consolidate the administration of
their respective county school systems under one remaining controlling multi-county board of
education. This consolidation could increase or decrease the obligations of certain county boards
of education that elect to form a consolidated school system dependent on the difference in: 1)
any costs or savings associated with consolidating the school systems, and; 2) the cost of
otherwise operating non-consolidated schools systems under current law.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of Education to
conduct an impact study on the potential effects of a proposed consolidation, and to adopt rules
to implement the provision of this bill.
This bill would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General
Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
